Helicopter Govindghat-Ghangaria one way about 3,000-3,500 (auli-resort.com 2025) or 3,500-4,000 (Dheeraj 2026); round trip quoted at about 10,500-10,800 incl. fees (Dheeraj; solobackpacker), which does not tie to the one-way figures; official booking is IRCTC HeliYatra and one search snippet said Hemkund heli booking was temporarily on hold. Rana Tourist Lodge, Lohajung: tariff table headed 'Cost Per Person Per Night' plus GST: 2-bedded 600, 3-bedded 900, 4-bedded 1,200, 5-bedded 1,500, so a double room is 1,200 if per person (600 if per room: the page is ambiguous). Lohajung Valley Stay homestay (Bank village): from 1,299 with breakfast, lunch and dinner included (Himalayas Homestays listing, 2025 host, no dates).
stay.notes: Most operators bundle Lohajung lodge nights into the trek fee (18,000-19,950 + 5% GST, see taxi notes). Lohajung also has a GMVN TRH and a panchayat TRH, no tariff found. No Wan homestay prices found. Cleartrip has no Lohajung page.

point_to_point.route: Rishikesh to Lohajung (roadhead), Tata Sumo/Bolero one-way, shared across the group (Himalaya Trekker)
Rishikesh to Lohajung, Bolero/Ertiga one-way (same operator's exclusions list)
Rishikesh to Lohajung, Tempo Traveller one-way, 12 seats

taxi_day.basis: Not a sightseeing destination: Roopkund is a multi-day trek from the Lohajung/Wan roadhead, so there is no local cab day (local_sightseeing_8h_inr is null). The cab is the roadhead transfer, as quoted by trek operator Himalaya Trekker (undated, paid directly to the driver). Trek fee for context: 18,000 + 5% GST (Himalayan Hikers, Dehradun to Dehradun) to 19,950 + 5% GST (Himalaya Trekker, Lohajung to Lohajung); rucksack offloading 3,000 for the whole trek.
taxi_day.notes: Lohajung to Wan is about a one-hour bumpy drive; no current fare found (a travelogue about a decade old mentioned 500 for 12 km: not usable). Roopkund trek reopened in 2026 after a 2018 High Court ban; operator lists autumn departures 17 and 31 Oct 2026. Independent trekkers need a permit and a registered guide, which was not checked.

food_per_person_day.basis: No standalone food prices: operators include all meals in the trek fee and the Lohajung homestay listing includes three meals in its 1,299 rate. No Lohajung/Wan menu found.
